column2:
packet(n.)小包、小袋、一包
pack(n./v.)包裹、打包
a packet of 一包…
sugar packet 糖包
She tore open a packet of instant noodles for a late-night snack.
(她撕開一包泡麵當作宵夜。)
Follow the instructions printed on the back of the seed packet.
(請依照種子包背面印的說明操作。)

paddle(n./v.)槳、用槳划、涉水
(無詞性變化)
paddle a canoe 划獨木舟
stand-up paddle board 立式划槳
We paddled our canoe slowly along the quiet river.
(我們沿著寧靜的河流慢慢划著獨木舟。)
The children paddled in the shallow water at the beach.
(孩子們在海邊的淺水中玩水。)

paperback(n.)平裝書
hardcover(n.)精裝書
in paperback 平裝版
a cheap paperback 便宜的平裝書
The novel will be available in paperback next month.
(這本小說下個月將推出平裝版。)
I prefer paperbacks because they are lighter and cheaper.
(我比較喜歡平裝書，因為它們比較輕也比較便宜。)

paradox(n.)矛盾、似非而是的論點、自相矛盾的人事物
paradoxical(adj.)矛盾的
paradoxically(adv.)矛盾地
a strange paradox 奇怪的矛盾
the paradox of choice 選擇的矛盾
It is a paradox that the more choices we have, the harder it is to decide.
(選擇越多反而越難做決定，這真是個矛盾。)
Paradoxically, the busiest people often find time to help others.
(矛盾的是，最忙碌的人往往能找到時間幫助別人。)

paralyze(v.)使癱瘓、使麻痺
paralysis(n.)癱瘓、麻痺
paralyzed(adj.)癱瘓的
be paralyzed by fear 嚇得動彈不得
paralyze traffic 使交通癱瘓
The heavy snowstorm paralyzed traffic across the entire city.
(大風雪使整座城市的交通陷入癱瘓。)
He was paralyzed from the waist down after the car accident.
(那場車禍後，他腰部以下癱瘓了。)

parliament(n.)國會、議會
parliamentary(adj.)國會的
member of parliament 國會議員
pass through parliament 經國會通過
The new law must be approved by parliament before it takes effect.
(新法律必須經國會通過才能生效。)
She was elected to parliament at the age of thirty.
(她三十歲時當選國會議員。)

pastime(n.)消遣、娛樂
(無詞性變化)
a favorite pastime 最喜歡的消遣
national pastime 全民休閒活動
Reading comics is one of my favorite pastimes on weekends.
(看漫畫是我週末最喜歡的消遣之一。)
Baseball is often called America's national pastime.
(棒球常被稱為美國的國民休閒運動。)

patriot(n.)愛國者
patriotic(adj.)愛國的
patriotism(n.)愛國心
a true patriot 真正的愛國者
a sense of patriotism 愛國情操
He was remembered as a true patriot who fought for his country.
(他被人們緬懷為一位為國奮戰的真正愛國者。)
The national anthem filled the crowd with a strong sense of patriotism.
(國歌讓群眾心中充滿強烈的愛國情操。)

patriotic(adj.)愛國的
patriot(n.)愛國者
patriotism(n.)愛國心
patriotic songs 愛國歌曲
patriotic spirit 愛國精神
The crowd sang patriotic songs during the national celebration.
(在國家慶典上，群眾高唱愛國歌曲。)
Fans waved flags to show their patriotic spirit at the Olympics.
(球迷在奧運會上揮舞國旗展現愛國精神。)

peacock(n.)(雄)孔雀
peahen(n.)雌孔雀
as proud as a peacock 像孔雀一樣驕傲
peacock feathers 孔雀羽毛
The peacock spread its beautiful tail feathers to attract attention.
(孔雀展開美麗的尾羽吸引目光。)
After winning the prize, he walked around as proud as a peacock.
(得獎後，他像孔雀一樣驕傲地四處走動。)

pebble(n.)小圓石、鵝卵石
pebbly(adj.)多卵石的
pebble beach 礫石灘
smooth pebbles 光滑的鵝卵石
The children collected smooth pebbles along the riverbank.
(孩子們沿著河岸撿光滑的鵝卵石。)
Qixingtan in Hualien is famous for its beautiful pebble beach.
(花蓮的七星潭以美麗的礫石灘聞名。)

peek(n./v.)偷看、窺視
(無詞性變化)
take a peek at 偷看一下
sneak a peek 偷瞄一眼
Don't peek at the answers before you finish the quiz.
(做完小考之前不要偷看答案。)
She took a quick peek at her birthday present before the party.
(派對開始前，她偷偷瞄了一眼她的生日禮物。)

pending(adj.)懸而未決的、待決的、即將發生的
(無詞性變化)
pending approval 等待批准
pending case 未決案件
The final decision is still pending until the manager returns.
(在經理回來之前，最終決定仍懸而未決。)
My visa application is pending approval from the embassy.
(我的簽證申請正在等待大使館核准。)

peninsula(n.)半島
peninsular(adj.)半島的
the Korean Peninsula 朝鮮半島
the Hengchun Peninsula 恆春半島
Kenting National Park is located on the Hengchun Peninsula.
(墾丁國家公園位於恆春半島。)
Italy is a long peninsula shaped like a boot.
(義大利是一個形狀像靴子的狹長半島。)

perch(n./v.)棲木、高處、(鳥)棲息、坐在高處
(無詞性變化)
perch on 棲息在…
a bird's perch 鳥的棲木
A small bird perched on the branch outside my window.
(一隻小鳥停在我窗外的樹枝上。)
The old castle is perched on top of a steep hill.
(那座古堡坐落在陡峭的山頂上。)

peril(n./v.)(嚴重的)危險、危及
perilous(adj.)危險的
in peril 在危險中
at one's peril 自行承擔風險
The sailors were in great peril during the violent storm.
(在猛烈的暴風雨中，水手們身陷極大的危險。)
You ignore the safety rules at your own peril.
(你若忽視安全規則，後果自負。)

perish(v.)死亡、毀滅、腐爛
perishable(adj.)易腐壞的
perish in a fire 死於火災
perishable food 易腐壞的食物
Hundreds of people perished in the earthquake.
(數百人在地震中喪生。)
Perishable food such as milk should be kept in the refrigerator.
(牛奶等容易腐壞的食物應存放在冰箱裡。)

permissible(adj.)可允許的、許可的
permit(v./n.)允許、許可證
permission(n.)許可
permissible level 容許標準
legally permissible 法律允許的
The pollution in the river was far above the permissible level.
(河川的汙染遠超過容許標準。)
Is it permissible to use a calculator during the exam?
(考試時可以使用計算機嗎？)

persevere(v.)堅持不懈、不屈不撓
perseverance(n.)毅力、堅忍
persevere with/in 堅持…
with perseverance 憑著毅力
If you persevere with your practice, your English will improve.
(如果你堅持練習，英文就會進步。)
Her perseverance finally paid off when she won the competition.
(當她贏得比賽時，她的毅力終於得到了回報。)

persistence(n.)堅持、持續、固執
persist(v.)堅持、持續
persistent(adj.)堅持的
with persistence 堅持不懈地
patience and persistence 耐心與毅力
Learning a musical instrument requires patience and persistence.
(學習樂器需要耐心和毅力。)
Thanks to his persistence, the team finally solved the problem.
(多虧了他的堅持，團隊終於解決了問題。)

persistent(adj.)持續的、堅持不懈的、固執的
persist(v.)堅持
persistently(adv.)持續地
persistent cough 久咳不癒
a persistent problem 持續存在的問題
You should see a doctor if you have a persistent cough.
(如果久咳不癒，你應該去看醫生。)
The salesman was so persistent that I finally bought the product.
(那位業務員非常鍥而不捨，最後我還是買了那項產品。)

petrol(n.)汽油(英式)
(無詞性變化)
petrol station 加油站
run out of petrol 汽油用完
We stopped at a petrol station to fill up the tank.
(我們在加油站停下來加滿油。)
The price of petrol has risen sharply this year.
(今年汽油價格大幅上漲。)

petroleum(n.)石油
(無詞性變化)
petroleum products 石油製品
crude petroleum 原油
Plastic is made from petroleum, a non-renewable resource.
(塑膠是由石油這種不可再生資源製成的。)
Many countries in the Middle East depend on petroleum exports.
(許多中東國家仰賴石油出口。)

pharmacist(n.)藥劑師
pharmacy(n.)藥局、藥學
ask a pharmacist 詢問藥師
licensed pharmacist 有執照的藥師
The pharmacist explained how often I should take the medicine.
(藥師解釋了我應該多久吃一次藥。)
If you have questions about side effects, ask your pharmacist.
(如果對副作用有疑問，請詢問你的藥師。)

pharmacy(n.)藥局、藥學
pharmacist(n.)藥劑師
pharmaceutical(adj.)製藥的
a 24-hour pharmacy 二十四小時藥局
study pharmacy 攻讀藥學
I picked up my prescription at the pharmacy near the hospital.
(我在醫院附近的藥局領了處方藥。)
She plans to study pharmacy at university next year.
(她打算明年在大學攻讀藥學。)

pianist(n.)鋼琴家、鋼琴師
piano(n.)鋼琴
a talented pianist 有天分的鋼琴家
concert pianist 演奏會鋼琴家
The young pianist gave a brilliant performance at the concert hall.
(那位年輕鋼琴家在音樂廳的演出非常精彩。)
She practices four hours a day because she wants to be a concert pianist.
(她每天練琴四小時，因為她想成為演奏會鋼琴家。)

pickpocket(n.)扒手
(無詞性變化)
beware of pickpockets 小心扒手
a skilled pickpocket 熟練的扒手
Beware of pickpockets in crowded places like night markets.
(在夜市等擁擠的地方要小心扒手。)
A pickpocket stole my wallet while I was on the crowded train.
(我在擁擠的火車上時，錢包被扒手偷走了。)

pilgrim(n.)朝聖者、香客
pilgrimage(n.)朝聖、朝聖之旅
make a pilgrimage 去朝聖
religious pilgrims 宗教朝聖者
Thousands of pilgrims follow the Mazu procession every spring.
(每年春天都有數千名香客跟隨媽祖遶境。)
For many music fans, visiting the singer's hometown is a kind of pilgrimage.
(對許多樂迷來說，造訪那位歌手的故鄉是一種朝聖之旅。)

pimple(n.)青春痘、粉刺
pimply(adj.)長滿青春痘的
get pimples 長痘痘
squeeze a pimple 擠痘痘
Many teenagers get pimples on their faces during puberty.
(許多青少年在青春期臉上會長痘痘。)
Don't squeeze your pimples, or they may leave scars.
(不要擠痘痘，否則可能會留下疤痕。)

pinch(n./v.)捏、擰、一撮、夾痛
(無詞性變化)
a pinch of salt 一小撮鹽
in a pinch 在緊要關頭
Add a pinch of salt to bring out the sweetness of the fruit.
(加一小撮鹽來帶出水果的甜味。)
I had to pinch myself to make sure I wasn't dreaming.
(我得捏自己一下，確定我不是在作夢。)

plague(n.)瘟疫、鼠疫、災害
(無詞性變化)
the Black Plague 黑死病
a plague of 大量的(有害的)…
The plague killed millions of people in Europe during the Middle Ages.
(中世紀時，瘟疫在歐洲奪走了數百萬條人命。)
The farmers suffered from a plague of locusts that destroyed their crops.
(農民遭受蝗災，作物全被摧毀。)

plantation(n.)農園、大農場、種植園
plant(n./v.)植物、種植
tea plantation 茶園
rubber plantation 橡膠園
We visited a tea plantation in Alishan and learned how tea is made.
(我們參觀了阿里山的一座茶園，學習茶葉的製作過程。)
Many workers on the sugar plantations lived in poor conditions.
(許多甘蔗園的工人生活條件很差。)

playwright(n.)劇作家
play(n.)戲劇
a famous playwright 著名劇作家
a young playwright 年輕劇作家
Shakespeare is the most famous playwright in the English language.
(莎士比亞是英語世界最著名的劇作家。)
The young playwright's first play was a huge success.
(那位年輕劇作家的第一部劇作大獲成功。)

plow(n./v.)犁、耕地、費力前進
(無詞性變化)
plow the field 犁田
plow through 費力地完成、穿過
In the past, farmers used water buffalo to plow their fields.
(過去農夫用水牛來犁田。)
I had to plow through a pile of homework over the weekend.
(我週末得費力地寫完一大堆作業。)

pneumonia(n.)肺炎
(無詞性變化)
catch pneumonia 罹患肺炎
severe pneumonia 嚴重肺炎
His cold turned into pneumonia, so he had to stay in the hospital.
(他的感冒轉成肺炎，所以必須住院。)
Elderly people are encouraged to get vaccinated against pneumonia.
(長者被鼓勵接種肺炎疫苗。)

polar(adj.)極地的、南北極的、正好相反的
pole(n.)極、極地
polar bear 北極熊
polar opposites 截然相反
Polar bears are losing their habitat as the Arctic ice melts.
(隨著北極冰層融化，北極熊正在失去棲息地。)
The two brothers are polar opposites in personality.
(這兩兄弟的個性截然相反。)

ponder(v.)仔細考慮、沉思
(無詞性變化)
ponder over/on 仔細思考…
ponder the question 思考這個問題
She pondered the question for a long time before answering.
(她思考了這個問題很久才回答。)
After graduation, he pondered over what career he should choose.
(畢業後，他仔細思考該選擇什麼職業。)

pony(n.)小馬
(無詞性變化)
ride a pony 騎小馬
pony tail 馬尾(髮型)
The children took turns riding a pony at the farm.
(孩子們在農場輪流騎小馬。)
She tied her long hair into a ponytail before the race.
(比賽前她把長髮綁成馬尾。)

populate(v.)居住於、構成人口
population(n.)人口
populated(adj.)有人居住的
densely populated 人口稠密的
sparsely populated 人口稀少的
Taipei is one of the most densely populated cities in Taiwan.
(臺北是臺灣人口最稠密的城市之一。)
The island was once populated by only a few fishing families.
(這座島曾經只有幾戶漁民居住。)

porter(n.)搬運工、行李員、門房
(無詞性變化)
hotel porter 飯店行李員
airport porter 機場行李搬運員
The hotel porter carried our heavy suitcases up to the room.
(飯店行李員把我們沉重的行李搬到房間。)
Porters help climbers carry supplies up the mountain.
(挑夫幫登山者把補給品背上山。)

posture(n./v.)姿勢、態度、擺姿態
(無詞性變化)
good posture 良好的姿勢
sitting posture 坐姿
Poor posture while using your phone can cause neck pain.
(使用手機時姿勢不良可能導致頸部疼痛。)
The government adopted a firm posture in the trade negotiations.
(政府在貿易談判中採取了強硬的態度。)

potent(adj.)強有力的、有效力的
potency(n.)效力、力量
a potent drug 強效藥物
a potent symbol 強而有力的象徵
This medicine is very potent, so follow the instructions carefully.
(這種藥藥效很強，請仔細遵照說明服用。)
The flag has become a potent symbol of freedom for the people.
(這面旗幟已成為人民追求自由的強烈象徵。)

poultry(n.)家禽、禽肉
(無詞性變化)
poultry farm 養雞場、家禽養殖場
poultry products 禽肉製品
The poultry farm raises thousands of chickens and ducks.
(這座家禽養殖場飼養了數千隻雞和鴨。)
Poultry should be cooked thoroughly to kill harmful bacteria.
(禽肉應該徹底煮熟以殺死有害細菌。)

preach(v.)講道、說教、宣揚
preacher(n.)傳教士
preach to 對…說教
practice what you preach 以身作則
My parents always preach about the importance of saving money.
(我爸媽總是對存錢的重要性說教。)
A good leader should practice what he preaches.
(好的領導者應該以身作則。)

precede(v.)在…之前、先於
preceding(adj.)前面的、在前的
precedent(n.)先例
precede sth. with 在…之前先…
the preceding chapter 前一章
A short speech by the principal preceded the award ceremony.
(頒獎典禮之前有校長的簡短致詞。)
The answer to this question can be found in the preceding paragraph.
(這個問題的答案可以在前一段找到。)

precedent(n.)先例、前例
unprecedented(adj.)前所未有的
set a precedent 開先例
without precedent 史無前例
The court's decision set an important precedent for future cases.
(法院的判決為未來的案件立下了重要先例。)
The pandemic caused unprecedented changes in the way we work.
(疫情對我們的工作方式造成前所未有的改變。)

precision(n.)精確、精準
precise(adj.)精確的
precisely(adv.)精確地
with precision 精確地
precision instruments 精密儀器
The surgeon performed the operation with great precision.
(外科醫生非常精準地完成了手術。)
Taiwan is known for producing precision machinery.
(臺灣以生產精密機械聞名。)

predecessor(n.)前任、前輩、前身
successor(n.)繼任者
one's predecessor 某人的前任
the predecessor of 某物的前身
The new principal is much stricter than her predecessor.
(新校長比她的前任嚴格得多。)
The new phone is lighter and faster than its predecessor.
(這款新手機比前一代更輕更快。)

prehistoric(adj.)史前的
prehistory(n.)史前時代
prehistoric times 史前時代
prehistoric animals 史前動物
Scientists discovered prehistoric tools in a cave in eastern Taiwan.
(科學家在臺灣東部的一個洞穴中發現了史前工具。)
Dinosaurs are the most famous prehistoric animals.
(恐龍是最有名的史前動物。)

premiere(n.)首映、首演
(無詞性變化)
world premiere 全球首映
movie premiere 電影首映會
Fans waited for hours outside the theater for the movie premiere.
(影迷在戲院外等了好幾個小時參加電影首映會。)
The musical will have its world premiere in London next spring.
(這齣音樂劇明年春天將在倫敦全球首演。)

preside(v.)主持、擔任主席
president(n.)總統、會長
presidency(n.)總統職位
preside over 主持…
preside at a meeting 主持會議
The principal presided over the graduation ceremony.
(校長主持了畢業典禮。)
The judge who presided at the trial was known for being fair.
(主持審判的法官以公正著稱。)

prestige(n.)聲望、威望
prestigious(adj.)有聲望的
a prestigious university 名校
gain prestige 獲得聲望
Winning the international award brought the school great prestige.
(贏得這項國際獎項為學校帶來極高的聲望。)
He was accepted by a prestigious university in the United States.
(他被美國一所名校錄取了。)

preventive(adj./n.)預防的、預防措施
prevent(v.)預防
prevention(n.)預防
preventive measures 預防措施
preventive medicine 預防醫學
The government took preventive measures to stop the spread of the disease.
(政府採取了預防措施來阻止疾病擴散。)
Regular checkups are an important part of preventive medicine.
(定期健康檢查是預防醫學的重要一環。)

preview(n./v.)預告片、預習、預覽
(無詞性變化)
movie preview 電影預告
preview the lesson 預習課程
Students are encouraged to preview the lesson before class.
(鼓勵學生在上課前預習課程。)
The preview of the new movie made everyone excited.
(新電影的預告讓大家都很興奮。)

priceless(adj.)無價的、極寶貴的
price(n.)價格
priceless treasure 無價之寶
priceless experience 寶貴的經驗
The museum's collection includes many priceless works of art.
(博物館的收藏包括許多無價的藝術品。)
Spending time with my grandparents is a priceless experience.
